notes: The constructor mints the entire fixed 1e27-unit supply to its deployer. The launch factory distributes the swarm's 10% and seeds 90% into the IMD pool; this token performs neither allocation. Transfers from the fixed PoolManager pay floor(amount/50) to the fixed tax wallet, except transfers to the PoolManager, which are always untaxed. Wallet transfers and distributor claims are untaxed. All withdrawals from the PoolManager, including liquidity removals, use this same address-based rule; routers must account for net receipts. No owner, admin, subsequent mint, burn, proxy or upgrade exists. The specified initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from the economics and actual currency order.
